name: GainSnap
summary: Toggle peak matching for Ableton tracks
description: GainSnap measures an incoming track peak while Match is enabled, continuously applies the gain needed to reach a chosen target while Match is enabled, and holds that gain when Match is disabled. Normalize sets the target to 0 dBFS and starts Match in one click. The vertical meter shows a smoothed orange output peak with a dB scale. A small triangle beside the meter marks the target and acts as the target control.
features: Live peak matching with a protected fade-in
Compact output meter and pulsing Match controls
Signed and notarized macOS CLAP and VST3
Unsigned Windows x86_64 VST3 nightly downloads
